translations.web: and they didn’t know until the flood came, and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
translations.bsb: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
translations.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
translations.asv: and they knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
